findings.title: Fix for the concurrent-delete NPE is only applied to getSubGroupsCount(), leaving identical bug in sibling getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() was changed to null-check the result of modelSupplier.get() before calling getSubGroupsCount() on it, to avoid an NPE when the backing group was concurrently deleted. However getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) (line 262) and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) (line 268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly without checking for null. If the group is concurrently removed from the DB while one of these methods is invoked (the exact scenario described in issue #40368), modelSupplier.get() will return null and these three methods will throw the same NullPointerException the PR claims to fix. The fix is incomplete and the underlying race condition remains reachable through these code paths.

findings.title: Background reading thread is not joined and can leak or produce false-negative assertions
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti(), a plain non-daemon Thread is started to repeatedly call groups() while the main thread deletes groups. After the delete loop finishes, deletedAll.set(true) is called and the assertion on caughtExceptions runs immediately with no Thread.join()/wait. There's a race: the main thread can read and assert on caughtExceptions before the background thread has finished its current REST call and recorded a thrown exception, so the test can pass even though the race condition actually occurred (false negative). In addition, if an earlier step throws (e.g. the fail() call in the creation loop, or an exception from groupUuuids.forEach(...).remove()) before deletedAll.set(true) is reached, the background thread's while(!deletedAll.get()) loop will never terminate, leaking a running thread that keeps hitting the admin API indefinitely and can interfere with subsequent tests or prevent clean JVM shutdown. The test should join the thread (with a timeout) and use try/finally to guarantee deletedAll is always set.

findings.title: Unrelated removal of private helper method bundled into the NPE bug-fix PR
findings.body: This PR removes the private method groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement(GroupModel, String) entirely, which has nothing to do with the stated purpose of the PR (fixing an NPE when accessing a group concurrently) and is not mentioned in the PR description. Bundling unrelated dead-code removal into a targeted bug-fix PR makes the change harder to review and bisect, and risks silently reverting functionality that may have been intended for use elsewhere (even though currently unused) without any explanation.
